div.div: مُدَمْلَكٌ Smooth and round; applied to a solid hoof; like مُدَمْلَقٌ and مُدَمْلَجٌ; and as applied to an iron head of an arrow or of a spear &c.: (S:) and so ↓ دُمْلُوكٌ applied to a stone: (M, K:) or the latter, thus applied, signifies [simply] round: (S:) and the former, smooth and even; or made smooth and even; syn. مُخَلَّقٌ [in the CK مُحَلَّقٌ]; applied to a stone, and to an arrow: (M, K:) and i. q. مَفْتُولٌ مَعْصُوبٌ [app. as meaning compact, or firm, in make; as though twisted]. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
